tasks.label: simulation
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch course_bringup sim.launch.py

tasks.label: simulation (headless)
tasks.detail: Same world without the Gazebo GUI, for slow machines
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch course_bringup sim.launch.py gui:=false

tasks.label: teleop
tasks.detail: Drive the robot with the keyboard
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard --ros-args -p stamped:=true
